content: When the mind is concentrated and turned backward on itself, all within us that is stubborn will have to give way.
author: Swami Vivekananda
explanation: In Raja Yoga, Swami Vivekananda explains that true self-mastery begins by turning the spotlight of awareness inward. When attention is no longer scattered by external stimuli, the deepest layers of the mind reveal their secrets, dissolving rigid habits and ignorance.
practicalInsight: Practice turning your attention inward during moments of restlessness. Rather than reacting to external triggers, pause and observe the observer within.
reflectionPrompt: What inner truth becomes clear when you quiet outer distractions and observe your own mind with calm detachment?
